name: expo-stack-premium-ui
description: The checklist that separates an app that feels built with care from one that feels generated — press feedback, restrained motion, haptics, keyboard behaviour, loading and empty states, native colours, sheets over modals. Use when building any interactive screen, and in audit mode when asked to polish, review UI quality, or make an app feel premium or native.
